skill.name: property-testing-guide
skill.description: Introduces property-based testing with proptest, helping users find edge cases automatically by testing invariants and properties. Activates when users test algorithms or data structures.

generated_query: I'm implementing a simple binary protocol for sending messages over a network. I have a `Message` struct with fields: `id` (u32), `timestamp` (u64), and `payload` (a string of up to 256 bytes). I've written `encode` and `decode` functions, but I'm worried about edge cases like empty payloads, very long strings, or unusual ID values. I need to make sure that encoding a message then decoding always gives back the exact same message, and that the decoder never panics on any valid encoded bytes. Can you help me write tests that automatically check these properties over hundreds of random inputs?
